name: metric-definition-popover
title: Metric definition popover
description: Explain a number where it is shown: an info button that opens the metric's definition, formula, source, freshness and owner, so people stop asking what it means.
docs: The panel is not in the page until it is opened, so it costs nothing on a table with fifty metrics. Pass `refreshedAt` and, when a source is stale after a different time, `staleAfterHours`. `now` is only for demos and tests. Long names, formulas and table names wrap inside the panel. Focus lands on the panel; Tab then reaches the close button, the copy button and the owner link.
